sources.primary_title: Omani tech firms showcase services at LEAP 2026 in Saudi
sources.verified_angle_summary: The Sultanate of Oman is participating in LEAP 2026 with a delegation of 24 technology companies. The participation is spearheaded by Oman's Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology as part of its efforts to support local startups through the 'Numou' programme. This initiative is designed to help growth-stage companies expand their presence in Saudi and wider regional markets, build partnerships, and explore investment opportunities. The Omani companies will showcase their technical products and solutions to investors and stakeholders in Riyadh. This represents a distinct ecosystem and regional cooperation angle, highlighting cross-border tech expansion between Oman and Saudi Arabia, which is not covered in the existing LEAP 2026 inventory.
sources.verified_key_facts: Oman's delegation to LEAP 2026 includes 24 technology companies; The participation is supported by the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology; The initiative is part of the 'Numou' programme aimed at growth-stage companies; The goal is to access Saudi and regional markets, and expand digital exports; Companies will hold business meetings to explore cooperation and partnerships; The event opened on Monday, August 31, 2026, in Riyadh.
